newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Trading suspended in NCC, Siab, Lundberg.
newsitem.headline: Trading suspended in NCC, Siab, Lundberg.

text.p: The Stockholm bourse said on Monday trading was suspended in the shares of real estate and construction companies NCC and SIAB, and Lundberg.
The bourse said more information would be released on Tuesday.
The Lundberg family controls Siab with 49.6 percent of capital and 51.3 percent of votes, including Lundbergs' stake.
All three shares fell on the Stockholm Stock Exchange on Friday. Lundbergs closed at 102.5 crowns on Friday, down 2.5, while SIAB ended 0.1 lower at 39.5 crowns and NCC slipped 0.5 to 86 crowns.
